body_html:
The Granada Deluxe High Back Multi-Tilter is built for the people who never leave their desk. With an infinite-position tilt lock, body-weight tension control, and a generously contoured high back, this ergonomic office chair adapts to the way you actually sit — so the workday is supported from the first meeting to the last email. Made in Canada by Global Furniture Group.

Features

  • Infinite-position tilt lock holds the chair at any recline angle you choose
  • Tilt tension adjusts to your body weight so you rock comfortably without pushing
  • Over 5" of full ratcheted back/lumbar height adjustment
  • Independent back-angle and seat-angle adjustment for posture changes throughout the day
  • Pneumatic seat-height adjustment (16–20 in) with a soft-descent gas lift
  • Adjustable seat depth and a waterfall front edge to ease pressure behind the knees
  • Height- and width-adjustable T-arms with urethane armcaps
  • Properly contoured BioPlush cushions for all-day comfort

Specifications

Overall dimensions are W26 x D23.5 x H45 in with a 300 lb weight capacity, riding on a five-star reinforced nylon base. Covered by Global's commercial seating warranty — limited lifetime on the frame, base and mechanism, with five years on upholstery, foam and mesh.

A verified OECM-eligible supplier, Brant Business Interiors makes it simple for Ontario school boards, hospitals, and municipalities to order without an open tender — and family-owned since 1964, we are happy to help private offices spec the right chair too.
